passages.text:
Re: Invite for Administrator Power: Dinner with Neal Mohan, Head of YouTube, March
29
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld Thursday, March 23, 2023 at 5:23:11 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Blair Mallin
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Theresa Banks, [contact omitted] A/AID FO Scheduling, [opaque block] [contact omitted]
Alexandra Veitch, [contact omitted] Amol Shalia, [contact omitted]
Hi Blair and Team USAID,
We completely understand, thanks so much for the consideration and please send the Administrator Neal's best.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 4:29 PM Blair Mallin <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Theresa,
Unfortunately, it looks like we have a conflict, but she really appreciates the invite!
Blair Mallin Fox
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 3:25 PM Theresa Banks - [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Blair,
Due to government ethics rules, Ambassador Power will need to pay the per person cost associated with
the dinner. As of now, the estimated per person cost, including gratuity and tax, is $220. This is usually
sent as an invoice 48hrs after the event from our Office of Compliance and Integrity.
Please let us know if you have further questions or you can also contact [opaque block] [contact omitted].
Theresa Banks
[opaque block]
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 2:51 PM Blair Mallin <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Josh, is dinner being covered by Youtube? Thanks!
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 11:33 AM 'Josh Blumenfeld' via A/AID FO Scheduling <[contact omitted]> wrote:
why don't we use this conference line so that Theresa can join too?
[opaque block] [opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 11:21 AM Alexandra Veitch < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
And with apologies, I'm adding my colleague Theresa who should have been on this original thread to coordinate logistics
from our end. Thanks to all!
On Thu, Mar 23,2023 at 7:59 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Perfect! I'm at [opaque block]
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 10:58 AM Blair Mallin <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Amazing, can I give you a call at 11:30a?
On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 10:57 AM 'Josh Blumenfeld' via A/AID FO Scheduling <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Blair, thanks for your note! Let me know if you have a few minutes to connect and I can answer any questions

On Thu, Mar 23, 2023 at 9:45 AM Blair Mallin <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Alexandra,
Possible to share attendees? And I know the aim is for informal conversation, but is there any run of show?
Thanks!
Blair Mallin Fox
On Wed, Mar 22, 2023 at 10:35 AM Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Alexandra,
Thanks for reaching out and for sharing Mr. Mohan's invitation. We're confirming receipt for Administrator Power and will
be in touch.
Best,
Amol
On Wed, Mar 22, 2023 at 10:31 AM Alexandra Veitch < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Administrator Power,
YouTube has been so grateful for the partnership with USAID that came from the meeting you and Susan
Wojcicki had last year. With Neal Mohan now the Head of YouTube, we are hoping you could join us for a small
private dinner and conversation. He will share his perspective on the next decade for YouTube and is
interested in discussing technology policy issues with you.
It will be a small, off-the-record conversation and we would love to have you join us.
Date: Wednesday, March 29, 2023
Time & Location: 630 PM, Washington DC (further details available upon RSVP)
We hope you're able to attend. Kindly RSVP and provide any dietary needs to Theresa (cc'ed).
Thanks,
Alexandra
Note: YouTube is pleased toprovide attendance at this event at no cost where appropriate under applicable laws. YouTube may
be required to report gifts to government officials or invoice you to avoid making an impermissible gift. Please contact [opaque block]
[opaque block] [contact omitted] if you have any questions, or if you'd like to reimburse YouTube for your attendance.
Alexandra N. Veitch
Director, YouTube Government Affairs and Public Policy,
Americas
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
Amol K. Shalia
Deputy Director of Scheduling for Operations
Office of the Administrator
USAID
[opaque block]
[contact omitted]
